title: Bazu Smasher
summary: Bazu Smasher repeatedly calls pairs of hulks as its health falls.
overview: Bazu Smasher repeatedly calls pairs of hulks as its health falls.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Plan for two hulks at each of 90%, 75%, 70%, 55%, 50%, 35%, 30%, 15% and 10%.
Control damage near adjacent thresholds so the group can collect each pair.
An extended disengagement clears the summoned hulks.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
